operations.description: List all eligible services for this vRack asynchronously
operations.longDescription:
This route allows asynchronous service eligibility requests. It means the route can be called several times until all the eligible services are returned.

While the `status` is set to `pending` the results are partial.

Once the `status` is set to `done`, all the eligible services have been found.

In the eventuality of errors getting specific service types, the errors will be listed in the `errors` field.

operations.description: Create a priority
operations.longDescription:
Create a priority.

This endpoint will create a new 'custom' routing priority.

You can create a new 'custom' routing priority if you have an additional IP block in your vRack in the same region or not.

You do not have to create a 'custom' routing priority for RTvRack 3AZ to work. If you add an additional IP block in a 3AZ region without any routing priority and any additional IP block, a 'default' routing priority will automatically be chosen for you.

Priorities must be set to `1`, `2` or `3` for each availability zone.

`1` stands for the availability zone with highest priority, which will handle traffic by default.

`2` is the availability zone with second-highest priority, which will handle traffic as soon as priority `1` availability zone is not available.

`3` is the availability zone with lowest priority, it will handle traffic if neither the availability zone with priority `1` nor the availability zone with priority `2` are available.

All availability zones in a 3AZ region must be set in the payload in order for the 'custom' routing priority to be created.
